98: func (efs *EmbeddedFS) ServeHTTP(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
99: 	path := strings.TrimPrefix(r.URL.Path, "/")
100: 
101: 	// Build candidate paths to try in priority order.
102: 	// Next.js static export with trailingSlash:true produces directory/index.html files,
103: 	// so directory-style paths (ending in / or lacking an extension) must check index.html first.
104: 	var candidates []string
105: 	base := filepath.Base(path)
106: 	hasExt := strings.Contains(base, ".") && !strings.HasSuffix(path, "/")
107: 
108: 	if path == "" || strings.HasSuffix(path, "/") {
109: 		// Root or explicit directory request
110: 		candidates = append(candidates,
111: 			"frontend/out/"+path+"index.html",
112: 		)
113: 	} else if hasExt {
114: 		// Direct file with extension
115: 		candidates = append(candidates,
116: 			"frontend/out/"+path,
117: 		)
118: 	} else {
119: 		// No extension — could be a Next.js route (e.g. "login", "menu")
120: 		candidates = append(candidates,
121: 			"frontend/out/"+path+"/index.html",
122: 			"frontend/out/"+path+".html",
123: 		)
124: 	}
125: 	// Always fall back to SPA root for client-side routing
126: 	candidates = append(candidates, "frontend/out/index.html")
127: 
128: 	var file fs.File
129: 	var resolvedPath string
130: 	for _, candidate := range candidates {
131: 		f, err := efs.files.Open(candidate)
132: 		if err != nil {
133: 			continue
134: 		}
135: 		stat, err := f.Stat()
136: 		if err != nil || stat.IsDir() {
137: 			f.Close()
138: 			continue
139: 		}
140: 		file = f
141: 		resolvedPath = candidate
142: 		break
143: 	}
144: 
145: 	if file == nil {
146: 		http.NotFound(w, r)
147: 		return
148: 	}
149: 	defer file.Close()
150: 
151: 	stat, err := file.Stat()
152: 	if err != nil {
153: 		http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusInternalServerError)
154: 		return
155: 	}
156: 
157: 	// Set content type based on resolved file extension
158: 	ext := filepath.Ext(resolvedPath)
159: 
160: 	// Service worker must always be revalidated so Chrome picks up updates
161: 	if strings.HasSuffix(resolvedPath, "service-worker.js") {
162: 		w.Header().Set("Cache-Control", "no-cache, no-store, must-revalidate")
163: 		w.Header().Set("Service-Worker-Allowed", "/")
164: 	}
165: 
166: 	switch ext {
167: 	case ".html":
168: 		w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "text/html; charset=utf-8")
169: 	case ".css":
170: 		w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "text/css")
171: 	case ".js":
172: 		w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/javascript")
173: 	case ".json":
174: 		if strings.HasSuffix(resolvedPath, "manifest.json") {
175: 			w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/manifest+json; charset=utf-8")
176: 		} else {
177: 			w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
178: 		}

180: 		w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "image/png")
181: 	case ".jpg", ".jpeg":
182: 		w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "image/jpeg")
183: 	case ".gif":

237: func newPrefixProxy(baseURL string, transport http.RoundTripper, sourcePrefix, targetPrefix string) (*httputil.ReverseProxy, error) {
238: 	target, err := url.Parse(baseURL)
239: 	if err != nil {
240: 		return nil, err
241: 	}
242: 
243: 	normalizePrefix := func(prefix string) string {
244: 		if prefix == "" || prefix == "/" {
245: 			return ""
246: 		}
247: 		return "/" + strings.Trim(strings.TrimSpace(prefix), "/")
248: 	}
249: 
250: 	sourcePrefix = normalizePrefix(sourcePrefix)
251: 	targetPrefix = normalizePrefix(targetPrefix)
252: 
253: 	proxy := &httputil.ReverseProxy{
254: 		Director: func(req *http.Request) {
255: 			req.URL.Scheme = target.Scheme
256: 			req.URL.Host = target.Host
257: 
258: 			incomingPath := req.URL.Path
259: 			if incomingPath == "" {
260: 				incomingPath = "/"
261: 			}
262: 
263: 			trimmed := incomingPath
264: 			if sourcePrefix != "" && strings.HasPrefix(trimmed, sourcePrefix) {
265: 				trimmed = strings.TrimPrefix(trimmed, sourcePrefix)
266: 			}
267: 			if trimmed == "" {
268: 				trimmed = "/"
269: 			}
270: 			if !strings.HasPrefix(trimmed, "/") {
271: 				trimmed = "/" + trimmed
272: 			}
273: 
274: 			if targetPrefix != "" {
275: 				if trimmed == "/" {
276: 					req.URL.Path = targetPrefix
277: 				} else {
278: 					req.URL.Path = targetPrefix + trimmed
279: 				}
280: 			} else {
281: 				req.URL.Path = trimmed
282: 			}
283: 
284: 			req.Host = target.Host
285: 		},
286: 		Transport: transport,
287: 		ModifyResponse: func(resp *http.Response) error {
288: 			ct := resp.Header.Get("Content-Type")
289: 			if sourcePrefix != "" && strings.Contains(ct, "text/html") {
290: 				body, err := io.ReadAll(resp.Body)
291: 				if err != nil {
292: 					return err
293: 				}
294: 				resp.Body.Close()
295: 				rewritten := strings.ReplaceAll(string(body), "/_next/static/", sourcePrefix+"/_next/static/")
296: 				rewritten = strings.ReplaceAll(rewritten, `"/_next/`, `"`+sourcePrefix+`/_next/`)
297: 				rewritten = strings.ReplaceAll(rewritten, "'/_next/", "'"+sourcePrefix+"/_next/")
298: 				resp.Body = io.NopCloser(strings.NewReader(rewritten))
299: 				resp.ContentLength = int64(len(rewritten))
300: 				resp.Header.Set("Content-Length", strconv.Itoa(len(rewritten)))
301: 			}
302: 			return nil
303: 		},
304: 	}
305: 	proxy.FlushInterval = -1
306: 
307: 	return proxy, nil
308: }

1068: 		if err == nil {
1069: 			ln.Close()
1070: 			return true
1071: 		}
1072: 		time.Sleep(300 * time.Millisecond)
1073: 	}
1074: 	return false

238: // initLogging initializes the logging system based on configuration
239: func initLogging(cfg *config.Config) (*zap.Logger, error) {
240: 	// Determine log level
241: 	var level zapcore.Level
242: 	switch cfg.Log.Level {
243: 	case "debug":
244: 		level = zapcore.DebugLevel
245: 	case "info":
246: 		level = zapcore.InfoLevel
247: 	case "warn":
248: 		level = zapcore.WarnLevel
249: 	case "error":
250: 		level = zapcore.ErrorLevel
251: 	default:
252: 		level = zapcore.InfoLevel
253: 	}
254: 
255: 	// Create encoder config
256: 	encoderConfig := zapcore.EncoderConfig{
257: 		TimeKey:        "timestamp",
258: 		LevelKey:       "level",
259: 		NameKey:        "logger",
260: 		CallerKey:      "caller",
261: 		FunctionKey:    zapcore.OmitKey,
262: 		MessageKey:     "message",
263: 		StacktraceKey:  "stacktrace",
264: 		LineEnding:     zapcore.DefaultLineEnding,
265: 		EncodeLevel:    zapcore.LowercaseLevelEncoder,
266: 		EncodeTime:     zapcore.ISO8601TimeEncoder,
267: 		EncodeDuration: zapcore.SecondsDurationEncoder,
268: 		EncodeCaller:   zapcore.ShortCallerEncoder,
269: 	}
270: 
271: 	// Get application data directory for log storage
272: 	appDataDir, err := getOSAppDataDir()
273: 	if err != nil {
274: 		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to get application data directory: %w", err)
275: 	}
276: 
277: 	// Primary log path: application data directory
278: 	appDataLogPath := filepath.Join(appDataDir, "logs", "server.log")
279: 
280: 	// Ensure app data log directory exists
281: 	appDataLogDir := filepath.Dir(appDataLogPath)
282: 	if err := os.MkdirAll(appDataLogDir, 0755); err != nil {
283: 		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to create app data log directory: %w", err)
284: 	}
285: 
286: 	// Create file writer for app data log
287: 	appDataFile, err := os.OpenFile(appDataLogPath, os.O_CREATE|os.O_WRONLY|os.O_APPEND, 0666)
288: 	if err != nil {
289: 		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to open app data log file: %w", err)
290: 	}
291: 
292: 	// Secondary log path: project directory. Prefer an explicit absolute path from the outer
293: 	// process, but fall back to the KNIRVSERVER project logs directory when we can locate it.
294: 	var multiWriter io.Writer
295: 	projectLogPath := ""
296: 	if projectLogDir := getProjectLogDir(); projectLogDir != "" {
297: 		projectLogPath = filepath.Join(projectLogDir, "server.log")
298: 		if err := os.MkdirAll(projectLogDir, 0755); err != nil {
299: 			return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to create project log directory: %w", err)
300: 		}
301: 		projectFile, err := os.OpenFile(projectLogPath, os.O_CREATE|os.O_WRONLY|os.O_APPEND, 0666)
302: 		if err != nil {
303: 			return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to open project log file: %w", err)
304: 		}
305: 		multiWriter = io.MultiWriter(appDataFile, projectFile)
306: 	} else {
307: 		multiWriter = appDataFile
308: 	}
309: 
310: 	// Create cores for file (both locations) and stdout
311: 	fileCore := zapcore.NewCore(
312: 		zapcore.NewJSONEncoder(encoderConfig),
313: 		zapcore.AddSync(multiWriter),
314: 		level,
315: 	)
316: 
317: 	stdoutCore := zapcore.NewCore(
318: 		zapcore.NewJSONEncoder(encoderConfig),
319: 		zapcore.AddSync(os.Stdout),
320: 		level,
321: 	)
322: 
323: 	// Combine cores - logs go to both file locations AND stdout
324: 	core := zapcore.NewTee(fileCore, stdoutCore)
325: 
326: 	// Create logger
327: 	logger := zap.New(core, zap.AddCaller(), zap.AddStacktrace(zapcore.ErrorLevel))
328: 
329: 	// Also redirect standard log output to file(s) for compatibility
330: 	log.SetOutput(multiWriter)
331: 
332: 	if projectLogPath != "" {
333: 		logger.Info("Logging initialized",
334: 			zap.String("app_data_log", appDataLogPath),
335: 			zap.String("project_log", projectLogPath),
336: 		)
337: 	} else {
338: 		logger.Info("Logging initialized",
339: 			zap.String("app_data_log", appDataLogPath),
340: 		)
341: 	}
342: 
343: 	return logger, nil
344: }

387: 		return "", fmt.Errorf("could not determine application data directory")

417: // NewServer creates a new KNIRV-SERVER backend server instance
418: // initOracleFromKeyFile loads the encrypted root.key file and initialises the oracle service.
419: // Returns nil (no error) when the key file is absent — oracle is simply not started.
420: // The password is read from ORACLE_KEY_PASSWORD env var (non-interactive/CI) or prompted
421: // from stdin when running interactively.
422: func loadSecretsFromKeyFile(logger *zap.Logger) (*pb.RootKeyFileContentProto, error) {
423: 	if logger == nil {
424: 		// Use a logger that writes to stderr so critical startup messages are
425: 		// always visible, even when the caller didn't provide a logger.
426: 		consoleLogger, _ := zap.NewProduction()
427: 		logger = consoleLogger
428: 	}
429: 
430: 	// Ensure .env files are loaded before checking environment variables.
431: 	// Try multiple search paths to find .env files with different environment names.
432: 	envSearchPaths := []string{
433: 		".env.development",
434: 		".env.testnet",
435: 		".env",
436: 		"../.env.development",
437: 		"../.env.testnet",
438: 		"../.env",
439: 		"../../.env.development",
440: 		"../../.env.testnet",
441: 		"../../.env",
442: 	}
443: 	for _, envPath := range envSearchPaths {
444: 		if err := gotenv.Load(envPath); err == nil {
445: 			logger.Info("Secrets: loaded environment file", zap.String("path", envPath))
446: 			break
447: 		}
448: 	}
449: 
450: 	configuredKeyPath, err := config.GetRootKeyPath()
451: 	if err != nil {
452: 		return nil, fmt.Errorf("secrets: could not resolve root key path: %w", err)
453: 	}
454: 
455: 	keyPath, err := knirvoracle.ResolveAndValidateRootKey(configuredKeyPath)
456: 	if err != nil {
457: 		logger.Info("Secrets not loaded", zap.String("configured_path", configuredKeyPath), zap.Error(err))
458: 		return nil, nil
459: 	}
460: 
461: 	var keyPassword []byte
462: 	if envPwd := os.Getenv("ORACLE_KEY_PASSWORD"); envPwd != "" {
463: 		keyPassword = []byte(envPwd)
464: 		logger.Info("Secrets: using ORACLE_KEY_PASSWORD from environment")
465: 	} else {
466: 		// Check if stdin is a terminal
467: 		if !term.IsTerminal(int(os.Stdin.Fd())) {
468: 			logger.Warn("Secrets not loaded: ORACLE_KEY_PASSWORD is unset and stdin is not a terminal",
469: 				zap.String("key_path", keyPath))
470: 			log.Printf("WARNING: root.key found at %s but ORACLE_KEY_PASSWORD is not set. "+
471: 				"API keys inside root.key (Gemini, DeepSeek, etc.) will NOT be propagated to KNIRVAGENT. "+
472: 				"Set ORACLE_KEY_PASSWORD or export GEMINI_API_KEY/DEEPSEEK_API_KEY directly.", keyPath)
473: 			return nil, nil
474: 		}
475: 		keyPassword, err = password.PromptForPassword("Enter root key password to load secrets: ")
476: 		if err != nil {
477: 			return nil, fmt.Errorf("secrets: failed to read password: %w", err)
478: 		}
479: 	}
480: 
481: 	content, err := password.LoadEncryptedKeyFile(keyPath, keyPassword)
482: 	if err != nil {
483: 		return nil, fmt.Errorf("secrets: failed to decrypt root.key: %w", err)
484: 	}
485: 
486: 	logger.Info("Secrets loaded from root.key", zap.String("key_path", keyPath))
487: 	return content, nil
488: }

619: 	// Initialize eBPF Manager first (required for P2P security integration)
620: 	ebpfManager := ebpf.NewManager()
621: 	ebpfConfig := &ebpf.Config{
622: 		Programs: []ebpf.ProgramConfig{
623: 			{Name: "syscall_trace", Enabled: true},
624: 			{Name: "sandbox_lsm", Enabled: true},
625: 			{Name: "virtual_ns", Enabled: true},
626: 			{Name: "telemetry", Enabled: true},

634: 		log.Printf("eBPF features will be disabled. This may be due to insufficient kernel capabilities.")
635: 		ebpfManager = nil // Disable eBPF if initialization fails
636: 	} else {
637: 		log.Println("eBPF Manager initialized successfully")
638: 	}
639: 
640: 	// Initialize XDP Manager and P2P Security Service (eBPF/XDP firewall integration)

644: 		if err := xdpManager.InitializeXDP(); err != nil {

646: 		} else {

651: 			} else {

655: 				} else {

2243: func (s *Server) runRollupLoop() {
2244: 	if s.rollupService == nil {

2246: 	}
2247: 
2248: 	pollInterval := s.rollupPollInterval
2249: 	if pollInterval <= 0 {

2251: 	}
2252: 
2253: 	ticker := time.NewTicker(pollInterval)
2254: 	go func() {
2255: 		defer ticker.Stop()
2256: 		for {
2257: 			select {
2258: 			case <-s.ctx.Done():
2259: 				return
2260: 			case <-ticker.C:
2261: 				batch, err := s.rollupService.BuildNextBatch(s.ctx)
2262: 				if err != nil {
2263: 					log.Printf("Warning: Failed to build rollup batch: %v", err)
2264: 					continue
2265: 				}
2266: 				if batch == nil {
2267: 				} else {
2268: 					submitted, err := s.rollupService.SubmitBatch(s.ctx, batch.ID)
2269: 					if err != nil {
2270: 						log.Printf("Warning: Failed to submit rollup batch %s: %v", batch.ID, err)

2272: 					}
2273: 
2274: 					log.Printf("Rollup batch submitted: %s (heights %d-%d)", submitted.ID, submitted.StartHeight, submitted.EndHeight)
